# 1 Enoch Chapter 76 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn-astr (Aramaic) | **Section:** Astronomical Book (Book of Luminaries)

---

**76:1** And-at-the-four-corners-of-the-earth I-saw four-winds which-scatter the-mist of-the-heaven and-remove it from-the-face-of-the-earth.

**76:2** And-there-are-four-winds: the-wind of-the-east which-blows from-the-east, and-the-wind of-the-north which-comes-down from-the-north, and-the-wind of-the-south which-rises-up from-the-south, and-the-wind of-the-west which-blows from-the-west.

**76:3** And-the-north wind is-the-wind of-the-cold, and-there-is-one-third of-it hail and-snow and-frost, and-the-remaining two-thirds of-it produce what-is-agreeable.

**76:4** And-as-for the-south wind, its-three-portals are: the-first portal is-the-portal of-the-rain and-dew, the-second portal is-the-portal of-the-fire, and-the-third portal is-the-portal of-storm and-dust and-drought.

**76:5** And-as-for the-east wind, its-three-portals are: the-first portal is-the-portal of-the-dew-and-of-life, the-second portal is-the-portal of-rain and-growth, and-the-third portal is-the-portal of-storm and-devastation.

**76:6** And-as-for the-west wind, its-three-portals are: the-first portal is-the-portal of-moisture and-life-giving, the-second portal is-the-portal of-fertility and-abundance, and-the-third portal is-the-portal of-storm and-devastation.

**76:7** And-as-for the-north wind, its-four-portals are: the-first portal is-the-portal of-frost, the-second portal is-the-portal of-snow, the-third portal is-the-portal of-cold, and-the-fourth portal is-the-portal of-frost and-drought.

**76:8** And-out-of these-seven-portals-of-the-winds issue-forth the-mist, the-dew, and-the-rain, and-the-cold, and-the-frost, and-the-snow, and-the-hail, and-the-hoar-frost-of-the-dew.

**76:9** And-these-seven portals correspond-to the-seven-portals of-the-heaven.

**76:10** And-out-of the-portals-on-the-east and-on-the-north come-forth the-winds which-are-beneficial, and-out-of-those-on-the-south and-on-the-west come-forth those-which-are-hurtful; and-from-the-upper-portals come-forth cold and-heat and-warmth.

**76:11** And-I-saw twelve-portals in-the-heaven, at-the-ends-of-the-earth, out-of-which the-winds-go-forth and-blow over-the-earth.

**76:12** Three-of-them are-open on-the-face-of-the-east, and-three-on-the-west, and-three-on-the-right-of-heaven, and-three-on-the-left.

**76:13** And-the-three-first are-the-east portals, and-three-are-the-north, and-three-after-those-the-south, and-three-are-the-west.

**76:14** Through-four-of-these-come-winds-of-blessing and-prosperity, and-from-those-eight-come-hurtful-winds: when-they-are-sent, they-bring-destruction on-all-the-earth and-on-the-water upon-it, and-on-all-who-dwell-therein, and-on-everything which-is-in-the-water and-on-the-land.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Chapter 76 catalogs the twelve wind-portals at the four cardinal points, distinguishing beneficial from harmful winds. The four-directional cosmology (east, west, north, south) is common in ancient Near Eastern literature.*
